target_length_symbols.population: full original target string; uppercase is the source transformation
target_length_symbols.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

requested_primer_occurrence_count.population: all ordered supplied primer occurrences, including identical strings
requested_primer_occurrence_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

native_group_count.population: all supplied native groups, including malformed/extraneous groups
native_group_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

known_native_hit_list_count.calculation: count intact saved groups having native hit lists
known_native_hit_list_count.population: retained source lists; missing lists are excluded, not empty
known_native_hit_list_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

retained_native_hit_occurrence_count.calculation: sum reported_hit_count over known intact groups
retained_native_hit_occurrence_count.population: every original native hit, including malformed, duplicate, overlapping and opposite-strand occurrences
retained_native_hit_occurrence_count.missing_behavior: null when no native hit lists are known, except explicit empty native-group population gives zero; known partial lists contribute only their actual retained occurrences

usable_saved_hit_count.population: retained hit rows agreeing with full operands; saved corruption is excluded
usable_saved_hit_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

plus_hit_count.population: usable saved hit rows, independently of source-acceptance compatibility
plus_hit_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

minus_hit_count.population: same usable saved population; palindromic +/- rows remain distinct
minus_hit_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

strand_known_hit_count.population: same usable saved population; unknown strands excluded
strand_known_hit_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

source_compatible_hit_count.population: usable rows satisfying source ordinal/sequence/window/mismatch/threshold checks; consistency, not confidence
source_compatible_hit_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

mismatch_count_sum.population: usable canonical equal-width hit comparisons; repetitions count repeatedly, never unique target coverage
mismatch_count_sum.missing_behavior: null without any known native hit-list population; an empty checked-comparison set sums to zero with denominator zero, never asserting zero mismatches for unsupported or corrupt hits

mismatch_count_denominator_hits.population: exact retained comparison population for mismatch_count_sum; excludes missing/unsupported/corrupt comparisons
mismatch_count_denominator_hits.missing_behavior: zero means no usable checked comparisons, not a measured zero mismatch count

primer_length_symbols.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

native_primer_length_symbols.population: the retained native string, even when it conflicts with the supplied occurrence
native_primer_length_symbols.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

candidate_windows_per_orientation.population: possible complete linear windows for one nonempty primer; a structural denominator, not proof of attempted execution
candidate_windows_per_orientation.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

candidate_oriented_windows.population: both source orientations, including palindromic duplicate orientations
candidate_oriented_windows.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

reported_hit_count.population: one native group; duplicates and malformed rows retained
reported_hit_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

native_mismatch_entry_count.population: every retained mismatch entry, including duplicate or malformed triples
native_mismatch_entry_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

compared_symbol_count.population: one canonical equal-width complete supplied placement; no gaps or indels
compared_symbol_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

identical_symbol_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

mismatch_count.population: same one-placement comparison; survives a conflicting native mismatch list, which remains explicit
mismatch_count.missing_behavior: null when its source/operand/saved cell is unavailable or incompatible; available independent observed counts survive

mismatch_fraction.population: one checked canonical placement; exact numerator/denominator retained; no significance or annotation confidence
mismatch_fraction.missing_behavior: null for unknown numerator or missing/zero denominator; empty-primer pseudo-hits are unsupported, never zero-mismatch science

coordinates.target_interval: [native position, position + full primer length), never clipped
coordinates.ordinals: original occurrence/group/hit/mismatch array indices; no renumbering after failures
coordinates.missing_behavior: null when bounds/strand/identity/compatibility or explicit original source paths are unavailable

definitions.source_semantics: literal <=1 mismatch, '+' ascending starts then '-' ascending starts, per ordered primer; source RC complements A/C/G/T only and leaves other symbols unchanged; unsupported noncanonical outcomes retained without IUPAC repair
definitions.completeness: all retained source rows only; recorded native outcome is preserved but no omitted hit is inferred or enumerated
